children: US business automation software firm's fiscal Q2 revenue rose 13%, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for fiscal Q2 met analyst expectations
Company announced executive leadership changes and a new board appointment
UiPath sees Q3 revenue between $440 mln and $445 mln
Company expects Q3 ARR between $1.992 bln and $1.997 bln as of Oct 31, 2026
UiPath forecasts full-year revenue between $1.789 bln and $1.794 bln
CUSTOMER MOMENTUM - Co said results reflect momentum from customers and partners around its automation platform
PLATFORM TRANSFORMATION - Management cited two years of platform transformation and strengthened execution as supporting Q2 performance
AI-DRIVEN OPPORTUNITIES - Co said AI is expanding automation opportunities and increasing demand for orchestration and governance
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", 17 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for UiPath Inc is $13.00, about 27.7% below its September 2 closing price of $17.99
The stock recently traded at 21 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 15 three months ago
